headline: Mortal Kombat - the game that created ratings
title: Mortal Kombat 1992 Facts | Fatalities and the ESRB | Classic Games
video_script: Mortal Kombat hit arcades in nineteen ninety two, made by Midway, designed by Ed Boon and John Tobias. It used real digitized actors and had Fatalities, gruesome finishing moves on a beaten opponent. It was so controversial that, together with a couple of other games, it led to the creation of the ESRB, the age rating system for video games. Who was your main? Comment below!
description: Mortal Kombat (1992, Midway; designed by Ed Boon and John Tobias): its Fatalities and digitized gore sparked the controversy that led to the ESRB.
